clauses.name: 17(a). Records and audit
clauses.head: (a) Licensee shall maintain current, accurate and complete
clauses.text: (a) Licensee shall maintain current, accurate and complete books and records relating to all payments due to Licensors pursuant to this Agreement, including without limitation manufacturing records. At any time during the term of this Agreement, and for a period of three (3) years after the termination of this Agreement, Licensee shall permit Licenser or Licenser's representative to examine, inspect, review and audit such books, records and copies and any source documents pertaining thereto. Such examination, inspection or audit shall take place during Licensee's normal business hours upon not less than three (3) business days' prior notice and shall not unreasonably interfere with Licensee's conduct of its business. Licenser or Licenser's designated representative may, at Licenser's expense, during the course of such examination, review or audit, make such copies and/or extracts of Licensee's books, records, copies and source documents that pertain to the royalties and other fees payable hereunder. Licenser's right to use a representative shall be subject to the execution by the representative of a confidentiality agreement reasonably proposed by Licensee in order to ensure that any confidential information disclosed thereby will be kept confidential and will be used only for the purposes of confirming Licenser's rights under this Agreement and ensuring compliance with the terms hereof by Licensee. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Licenser and its representative, if any, shall have the right to make reasonable inquiries and request documents of, and to receive prompt responses from, Licensee, at any time and from time to time, to confirm Licenser's rights under this Agreement and to ensure compliance with the terms hereof by Licensee. Should any audit reveal a payment shortfall of more than five percent (5%) of the amounts due to Licenser for any consecutive three-month period, Licensee shall reimburse Licenser for all direct costs of performing the audit. The amount of any shortfall (whether or not in excess of such percentage) shall be paid promptly following its discovery without interest. The amount of any overpayment shall, at Licenser's option, be refunded by Licenser to Licensee or credited against royalties payable by Licensee to Licenser.

clauses.text: (b) Licenser is limited to two requests under subsection (a) of this Section per year; provided, however, that an additional request is permitted in event a prior request during that year revealed a shortfall of more than five percent (5%) of the amounts due Licensee for any consecutive three-month period.
